title: Defences: input and output validation, allowlists and filters

videos.script: No single filter stops everything a model can get wrong. So a reply passes through several, one after another, and each one looks for a different thing. {{title}} In the lab the chain has four layers. Personal data, a marker hidden in the system prompt, moderation, and the hosts a link may point to. {{chain}} Six replies written by the course go in. Two come out. {{results}} Each block names the layer that made it, so that somebody can trace it later. {{trace}} Then the difference between two kinds of list. A list of bad words misses the word spelt with a zero. A list of good values refuses everything it does not name. {{lists}} Last, the marker. If a reply repeats it, the system prompt has leaked, and somebody is told. If a reply paraphrases the prompt instead, the marker is not there, and the filter says nothing. {{canary}}
